author: LeAnne Marie McPherson
title: Celina Councilman Stephen Schulte arrested for suspected OVI - NewsBreak
text:
By LeAnne Marie McPherson ,
10 hours ago DAYTON, Ohio ( WDTN ) – Celina City Councilman Stephen Schulte (Republican-Ward 1) was recently arrested for allegedly driving under the influence on Sunday evening.
According to our partner paper The Daily Standard , an off-duty Auglaize County Sheriff's Office deputy and an off-duty St. Marys police officer saw two intoxicated men get into their vehicles at the Northmoor Golf Course. The officials told the men who they were and said they shouldn’t drive.
The officials alleged the men became hostile and went to the clubhouse. One of the officials documented the vehicle registration numbers / descriptions before leaving.
Woman dead after concrete mixer crash in Shelby County One of the officials followed the men and saw the Chevrolet truck “straddling the white line”. He turned on his overhead lights, and the Chevrolet stopped in the Celina Moose Lodge parking lot.
Celina City Councilman Stephen Schulte, WDTN file photo. Councilman Stephen Schulte reportedly told the official he was a city council member and had had “one” drink at the golf course. The official alleged he could smell alcohol from the truck, Schulte's eyes were watery and he stood unsteady.
He administered Standardized Field Sobriety Tests, which Schulte allegedly struggled with and was “unable to perform”.
The official then arrested Schulte for suspected OVI. As he was arrested, he reportedly asked the official if he understood he was arresting a city council member. The official said he was doing his job.
Schulte was booked and spent approximately an hour and a half in the jail before being released.
2 NEWS has reached out to the Celina City Council, Schulte and other officials for comment.
